observations: Photo 0 shows the control panel of a front-loading washing machine.
The brand 'Snowflake Drum' is visible on the top left of the panel.
Model number 'WTC1802' is printed vertically next to the brand.
The display shows a green 'E1' error code.
The control panel has several illuminated buttons and indicators, including 'Power', 'Start/Pause', and settings for wash, spin, and temperature.
The machine's exterior has a black, marbled finish with visible scratches and wear.
A watermark 'CHOICE TECHNICAL SERVICES' is overlaid on the image.
The seller's text mentions repair, installation, and servicing of faulty washing machines, not selling a machine.

risks.proof: A video or photo showing the machine running through a full cycle without error, or a technician's diagnosis report.

risks.proof: A full 360-degree photo or video of the machine's exterior and interior.
